method: Two independent SQLite backups of the same optimized historical copy. Read actual local Codex file-change items using read_history_source, register evidence, compact with fresh source, compare original reference and recovered digest, reopen Store and repeat using fetched evidence. No model tasks or production database replacement.

beforeStatusReconstruction.scope: isolated database copy; no production migration; reopen reuses fetched source evidence
beforeStatusReconstruction.source: local Codex read-only API; source binding checked before and after read

afterStatusReconstruction.scope: isolated database copy; no production migration; reopen reuses fetched source evidence
afterStatusReconstruction.source: local Codex read-only API; source binding checked before and after read

reclaimedBytesMeaning: Gross history-cache reclamation reported by compact; source proof metadata costs are not subtracted. Not physical file shrinkage.
limitations: File-change sample only; not evidence for all item types.
Store reopen reuses fetched source; not a fresh source process restart test.
No browser acceptance or full regression.
